'''Melisinde''' is a historical heroine. Her stories are told in ''[[The Flame, the Blade and the Heart]]''.

== Activities ==
While reading ''The Flame, the Blade, and the Heart'', [[Egwene al'Vere]] wishes she were as strong as Melisinde.{{ref/book|5|24}}

It is unknown whether she is a [[Hero of the Horn]] or not.
